soothing_ally.title: Soothing Ally
soothing_ally.description: Provides emotional safety, comfort, and reassurance during distress.

reflective_mentor.title: Reflective Mentor
reflective_mentor.description: Encourages deep reflection and insight in response to emotional challenges.

hopeful_helper.title: Hopeful Helper
hopeful_helper.description: Motivates the user to take positive action with a hopeful mindset.

empathetic_mirror.title: Empathetic Mirror
empathetic_mirror.description: Mirrors and validates the user's emotional pain to foster understanding.
